learning_outcomes.text: He/She can explain the basic steps of finite element methods.
He/She can model structural elements using the finite element method.
He/She can analyze an engineering structure using the finite element method.
He/She can use any proposed package program for structural analysis.

syllabus_topics: Modelling of one dimensional problems by finite element method.
The minimum potantial energy formulation. Weighted residual methods.
Modelling of truss systems by finite element modelling. Introduction to ANSYS packaged software.
Two and three dimensional truss systems. Solution of truss systems by ANSYS packaged software
Derivation of linear, quadratic and cubic elements shape functions for the one dimensional mesh elements.
ANSYS solutions of two dimensional elasticity problems. Shape functions of the rectangular elements.
Derivation of the linear triangular element shape functions.
ANSYS solutions of plane elasticity problems by using different elements.
Solutions of beam problems by ANSYS packaged software.
Three dimensional example problems by ANSYS; Solid mechanics problems.
Three dimensional example problems by ANSYS; Heat transfer and vibration problems.
bibliography: Xiaolin Chen, Yijun Liu, Finite Element Modeling and Simulation with ANSYS Workbench,CRC Press, 2015.
Saeed Moaveni, (ÇEVİRİ: Ali Osman Ayhan), Sonlu Elemanlar Analizi Teori ve ANSYS ile uygulamalar, Palme yayıncılık, 2015.
Saeed Moaveni, Finite Element Analysis Theory and Application with ANSYS, Prentice Hall, 4th Ed., 2017.
